description.value: Peninsula Co-op's Aspen Gas Centre is a member-owned co-operative gas station and convenience store in Comox, one of 17-plus Co-op fuel locations spanning Victoria, Duncan, Comox, and Campbell River. Cyclists can resupply on snacks and convenience staples, swap a propane bottle for camping stoves, and grab a coffee before continuing along the Comox Valley. As a co-operative, regular shoppers who join as members earn an annual rebate on purchases.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the 'Aspen Gas Centre' Peninsula Co-op location at 699 Aspen Rd, Comox, BC V9M 4H6; phone (250) 339-1955 matches OSM exactly. The location page title explicitly calls it a 'Convenience store' (positive evidence for basic groceries), and the services list confirms 'Propane – Bottle Exchange' on-site. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or pump are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM address '699 Aspen Road' omits city and postal code; website provides the complete address '699 Aspen Rd, Comox, BC V9M 4H6'.
OSM category 'Groceries' is a loose fit — this is primarily a gas station convenience store, not a full grocery store — though the confirmed convenience store component makes the category defensible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible convenience store and gas station with confirmed cycling-relevant amenities (propane bottle exchange, basic groceries).
